items.title: AbbVie (ABBV) Wins EU Approval For RINVOQ In Vitiligo And Alopecia
items.summary: AbbVie (NYSE:ABBV) received European Commission approval for RINVOQ (upadacitinib) as the first systemic treatment in the EU for non segmental vitiligo. The decision also covers RINVOQ as a systemic option for severe alopecia areata in adults and adolescents. These approvals expand RINVOQ’s labeled uses in Europe and add new indications in dermatology and immunology.
